# shoal_permissions (Data Source)

Every permission the server knows (`GET /v1/permissions`), for building custom roles.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "shoal_permissions" "all" {}

# A read-everything role built from the server's permission list.
resource "shoal_role" "auditor" {
  name        = "auditor"
  permissions = [for p in data.shoal_permissions.all.all : p if endswith(p, ":read")]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `all` (Set of String)
- `namespace` (Set of String) Permissions that apply inside a namespace.
- `tenant` (Set of String) Permissions only granted by tenant-wide bindings.
